how_pin_was_stabilised: Two 1 mm long radius-1 mm soft pads bond to the pin end faces; their outer faces were fixed. They carried 0.134 N (0.027%) in the accepted 4 mm run.
why: Only one 4 mm no-penetration contact study returned. It showed 499.866 N through the block contact path and 0.134 N through the pads, but the 3 mm refinement had 26,611 nodes and stopped at an unrecognized Fixture <Fixed-1> transfer failed dialog. After the hard cutoff, acknowledging that failed setup let the helper report excessive displacement; no result was read. Contact convergence, the same-direction tiny-load proof and bonded proof remain incomplete.
notes: One accepted coarse result only; not a converged peak bearing stress. The 5.290 MPa VM and 0.124 mm mean pin midspan rise are single-mesh values. The 3 mm run was invalid and discarded; the task remains partial.

failed_attempt.failure: Fixture <Fixed-1> transfer failed dialog; after cutoff helper reported excessive displacements and static() raised before result readback.
